edges.reason: msg.sender is compared to address(this); only a successful self-call passes the owner check.
msg.sender must equal the signed executor (or executor must be address(0)) before execution proceeds.
setOwners forwards to the private setOwners_ helper after the self-call check.
constructor initializes owner state by calling setOwners_.
threshold_ is written into the threshold state variable.
owners_ is assigned wholesale to ownersArr.
user supplied threshold is propagated to the threshold state variable.
user supplied owner array is propagated to ownersArr.
setOwners_ clears and rewrites the isOwner mapping entries.
lastAdd ordering constraint guards duplicate owners entering the isOwner mapping.
loop counter drives the mapping cleanup and rebuild loops inside setOwners_.
nonce is embedded in the signed hash and then incremented with unchecked 0.4.24 arithmetic (nonce = nonce + 1).
execute mutates the nonce state variable before performing the external call.
threshold bounds the signature array lengths and the signer recovery loop.
isOwner mapping is read to validate every recovered signer address.
The arbitrary low-level call to destination can invoke back into execute (or other state changing paths) without a reentrancy guard.
destination is the target of the assembly call.
value is forwarded as the call value.
data is forwarded as the call payload.
gasLimit is supplied to the assembly call.
executor is hashed into the EIP712 transaction digest for authorization.
recovered signer address is checked against the isOwner whitelist.
sigV is used by ecrecover inside execute.
sigR is used by ecrecover inside execute.
sigS is used by ecrecover inside execute.
lastAdd constrains successive recovered signer ordering.
success captures the boolean result of the assembly call.
DOMAIN_SEPARATOR is mixed into the EIP712 totalHash used for signature verification.
constructor writes DOMAIN_SEPARATOR.
chainId parameter is hashed into the domain separator.
loop counter iterates over the signature arrays during signer recovery.

normalization_plan.reason: parameter threshold_ of setOwners_ is only used to write state; fold it into the setOwners_ function node.
parameter owners_ of setOwners_ feeds ownersArr and isOwner; fold it into the setOwners_ function node.
threshold_ of setOwners is a forwarding parameter bound to the external access-controlled entry point.
owners_ of setOwners is a forwarding parameter bound to the external access-controlled entry point.
chainId parameter only contributes to the DOMAIN_SEPARATOR computed in the constructor.
destination parameter directly targets the unsafe low-level call.
value parameter is forwarded as the call value of the unsafe low-level call.
data parameter is forwarded as the call payload of the unsafe low-level call.
executor parameter is only used in the execute authorization hash.
gasLimit parameter configures the unsafe low-level call.
sigV is consumed only inside the execute signature verification loop.
sigR is consumed only inside the execute signature verification loop.
sigS is consumed only inside the execute signature verification loop.
loop counter i only indexes the arrays rewritten by setOwners_.
lastAdd guard local is only meaningful inside setOwners_ ordering checks.
lastAdd guard local is only meaningful inside the execute signer loop.
recovered address local is produced and validated only inside execute.
success local is the direct return flag of the unsafe low-level call.
loop counter i only indexes the signature arrays inside execute.
